policy.purpose: Change topic/path -> authorities -> current docs/generated artifacts/historical evidence/external surfaces. Review before editing and after final diff; do not read whole chat.

field_semantics.triggers: Changed input paths/globs; topic can be selected before files exist.
field_semantics.authority: Implementation/generator or dedicated factual reference; read relevant portions.
field_semantics.review: Current explanatory copies to check; not mandatory edits.
field_semantics.artifacts: Generated or published files; consider rebuild only when applicable.
field_semantics.historical: Dated/version-specific evidence; preserve observations, append corrections/follow-ups with date.
field_semantics.external: Independent publication surface, not updated by Git commit alone.
field_semantics.checks: Semantic review obligations, not automatic test results.

policy.matching: Any matching path in triggers/authority/review/artifacts/historical selects that group. Multiple matches are expected; filter actual required edits using scope and record reasons.
authority_order: actual implementation + release profile for current behavior
specific measured evidence for test claims
official references/contributor reports with exact version for compatibility
dedicated current guide for explanatory summaries
policy.history_rule: Do not blanket-replace old values in historical tests. If current docs summarize old evidence, make chronology/scope explicit. New implementation is not new proof.
policy.publication_rule: Read fresh remote state, publish only authorized changes, verify actual remote content; mark remaining work pending. No credentials or private deployment names in public files.

github_release_bodies.rule: Source Markdown is intended body. Before PATCH, compare fresh remote. After PATCH, compare exact body. Preserve flags/assets/tag/latest. Other versions are historical unless explicitly selected.

github_release_assets.rule: Verify affected asset version/name/size/hash/download against committed generation inputs. Preserve unrelated assets and all DNS payloads on docs-only edits.

repository_mirrors.rule: If mirroring is configured privately, push intended branches and verify source trees; do not expose private remotes or merge private history into public.

github_issues.rule: Template source lives in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE. Report facts may update docs; sending replies needs explicit user authorization.

github_repository_metadata.rule: Repository About/settings are external and not updated by README commits; change only if authorized.

groups.title: 進捗・完了・エラー表示と試験要約
checks: Recompute display count from release bytes and log sites; do not replace operation stage numbers.
Review ALL completion examples, count explanations, and test-summary paragraphs in installer.md, including HTTPS distribution section.
A historical nine-stage observation remains nine-stage; append dated follow-up with version, mode, transport, and actual results.
Changed bundle bytes/ref also select online-installer for command/image/publication review. Documentation-only corrections do not rebuild bundles.

groups.title: オンライン導入・固定コマンド・保存・復旧
checks: Keep payload version/bytes/SHA/commit distinct from installer commit/bytes; committed bundles are the command input.
Generate commands using tools/installer_command.py for each affected version and mode; compare literals in README, installer.md and maintained Release bodies; search remaining copies.
Inspect command text in PNG/SVG screenshots; recreate or explicitly label older examples. Do not invent a real screenshot or change command characters.
Check WebGUI acceptance vs completion, save semantics, no/yes behavior, schedule IDs, task checks, rollback, and restart guidance.
Respect existing version pins; do not replace an existing version payload with a new DNS release.
Review result summaries even if the link target is already correct; preserve dated test scopes.

groups.title: 削除対象・自動起動解除・保存・再導入
checks: Regenerate bundle only after source change; pin command to committed output and verify length with tools/build_uninstaller.py --ref.
Check exact deletion scope, matching schedules, saved/running configuration effects, idempotence, failure state and reinstall links.
WebGUI command acceptance is not successful completion; console output and WebGUI status instructions differ.

groups.title: 概要・導入画面・TCP補完図・導線
checks: Keep two short sections: online installation and capabilities. Link technical details; avoid repeated download links and audience labels.
README Mermaid and Release PNG diagrams describe the same UDP/TCP flow. Re-render affected editable diagrams and visually inspect.
Release image URLs may pin main or a tag; editing main cannot update a tag-pinned image. Never move a published tag to refresh an image.
Keep commands exact, mask identifiers in illustrations, and distinguish illustrations from real screenshots.
Verify relative links, section anchors, direct Issue template links and mobile-friendly download links.

groups.title: DNS選択・PP/DHCP・IPv4切替・定期更新
checks: Config reload requires explicit script restart; periodic refresh concerns dynamic PP/DHCP state. Review this distinction whenever polling changes.
Keep selection priority, source-address matching, IPv6-only fallback, unknown acquisition state, explicit refusal and AAAA filtering consistent.
Reflect user-visible capability changes in selected new Release details; do not assign new behavior to old releases.
When publishing changed runtime code, also select release-publication for version/build/installer/assets review.

groups.title: 機種・ファームウェア・API・インターフェース・動作報告
checks: Record model, firmware, script version, test scope, source link and observed/reported/expected distinction.
OEM report does not prove the native model or a different firmware/script revision; do not infer unknown minimum firmware.
Check official Lua/API support and accepted interface forms separately from successful native tests.
A report may require only a compatibility-row update; inspect duplicated summaries and record no-change reason.
Issue replies are external messages and require explicit authorization, separate from documentation edits.
When publishing changed runtime code, also select release-publication for version/build/installer/assets review.

groups.title: DNS wire・キャッシュ・接続/流量制限・タイムアウト
checks: Reconcile defaults/units/ranges in config and runtime with parameter tables and limits.
Separate upstream TCP 65535-byte limit from built-in UDP receive limit, cache limits, client caps, and send timeout start.
Review security/abuse and normal-vs-unrestricted-test claims; new code is not validated by old test results.
If conceptual routing changes, also review quick-start diagrams; if release payload changes, select release-publication.

groups.title: 機能・セキュリティ・負荷・不具合の根拠
checks: New measurements need version/hash, model/firmware, test profile, restrictions, inputs, denominator, failures and limitations.
Differentiate production defaults and diagnostics with relaxed safeguards; retain the distinction in reboot/performance summaries.
Update current summaries and known-issue resolution status from evidence; append dated results rather than replacing old observations.
Do not publish private router names/IPs, raw configs, credentials or identifying screenshots.

groups.title: 版・ビルド・配布物・Release本文・同期
checks: New version: add/select its short Release body and details; update external mappings and desired default install version explicitly. Do not assume prerelease means stable/latest.
Verify version/bytes/SHA/commit across payload, manifest, checksum, installer and published downloads.
Fetch fresh remote state; preserve assets/flags/tag/latest on body-only edits. Repository push alone does not publish Release edits.
Build once from intended config, verify, then publish authorized artifacts; do not silently replace existing version payload.
Record source commit, tag, mirrors, body and download readback separately; public source and private history need not share commit IDs.

groups.title: ビルド手順・試験実行・開発設定
checks: Examples distinguish local test (loopback, finite duration) and release (auto config) profiles.
Check documented test commands and new tools; avoid adding runtime requirements for documentation-only tooling.
Keep integer Lua and YAMAHA API assumptions explicit.

groups.title: 生成元・ライセンス・免責・公開範囲
checks: Retain Codex provenance statement; do not add or change software licenses without user direction.
Review provenance when adding external code/dependencies; old search results cannot prove all later code has no overlap.
Repository About is separate from README; update only when authorized and within scope.

groups.title: 資料追加・移動・対応表・保守手順
checks: Add semantic groups/edges for new files instead of broad catch-all patterns that hide missing dependencies.
Validate paths, topic IDs and relevant-file coverage; exercise installer progress and another independent topic.
Keep private memory routing synchronized locally; never embed private memory or deployment paths in public map.
Inventory coverage does not prove all semantic relationships; review the map when requirements change.
